name: dsh-pet-powercontext
description: Animated desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness with PowerContext long-term memory, chat, voice and independent model configuration.
_comment: ESM package. main points to lib/index.js, the Cordis host entry exporting name/inject/apply.
icon is a package-relative svg/png/jpg/jpeg/webp image up to 256 KiB. Its realpath must remain within the package; DSH iconOf embeds it as a data URL in meta.icon.
exports[./client] exposes the browser entry at /plugins/dsh-pet-powercontext/client.js.
dsh.bundle.patch adds cordis.patch.yml to the configuration layers when the bundle is installed.
dsh.client declares browser dependencies and the web platform.

dsh.compatibility.dshReleases records compatible/incompatible/unknown for exact official DSH releases. Keep only the latest three releases, with at least one verified compatible. Installation uses engines.dsh and peerDependencies; this evidence list is for the store.

files is the npm publication allowlist. VP9-alpha WebM supports Chrome, Edge, Firefox and desktop mode. Safari HEVC assets can be built separately; preview GIFs and HEVC assets are not published in this package.
encode:webm converts step03 masters into 640x360 VP9-alpha assets/webm files.
build creates all artifacts through scripts/prepare.js. Run it after cloning; prepack also runs it for npm pack and npm publish.

prepack builds, checks types/lint/format/cycles/runtime/assets/OpenAPI, then packs. Do not add an install-time prepare hook: scripts/prepare.js is not distributed, so approving that hook in npm 11 would fail with ENOENT.
bin.dsh-pet-powercontext and the compatible dsh-pet-standalone alias run lib/standalone.js without DSH. Source is in src/standalone; tsdown builds the entry.
peerDependencies are provided by the DSH host and are not bundled.
engines follows the minimum Node.js version required by @electron/get@5.1.0.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:cycles && npm run check:runtime && npm run format:check && node scripts/prepack-check.js && npm run check:openapi
